etsy.title: Hat Trick Hockey Poster, Three Goals Hats Optional Print, Funny Wall Art, Player Gift
etsy.description:
A hat trick hockey poster celebrating three goals with hats optional, featuring a playful three-hat graphic and bold lettering.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a game room, garage, man cave, or hockey locker room.

This listing is a physical poster print. Generic design: no league, team, or club marks. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy has a 'Hat Trick!' poster with hats raining onto ice, and a cat-themed 'Hairball Hat Trick' parody at $19.99.
A vinyl wall decal set includes Hat Trick, Slap Shot, and Power Play text.
Most hockey wall art on Etsy is personalized jerseys or digital downloads.
Amazon hockey posters are heavily personalized or motivational; few are humor-based.
Ice hockey poster prices on Amazon range from about $14.99 for tin signs to $47.99 for large canvas.

research.notes: Hat trick is among the most recognized hockey terms. Few funny physical poster prints use it on Etsy, where the space is dominated by custom jersey art and digital downloads.
